# The Gen X Factor

> The Gen X Factor is a new network where Gen X women (born roughly 1965 to 1980) find each other to hire, work and build. It connects women who've left corporate, been laid off, started something or want to. Founded in 2026 in Michigan by Blagica Bottigliero. Free for founding members.

## What members can do
- Hire experienced Gen X women: designers, marketers, operators and finance people
- Find freelance or fractional work with founders who want experience
- Find a partner or co-founder at the same life stage
- Connect with women who've changed careers
- Find peers and advisors who share the same references and reality

## How it works
1. Fill out one short form (about three minutes)
2. When there's a good match or small group, The Gen X Factor reaches out by email
3. Members take it from there: coffee, a call, a project or a company

No app, no feed. Details are shared with a match only after a member agrees and are never sold.

## Why Gen X women
- 54% of Americans in their 40s are sandwiched between an aging parent and their own kids (Pew Research Center, 2026)
- 13% of working women 45 to 60 reported a negative work outcome from menopause symptoms (Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 2023)
